flood.depth_reference: water depth above first finished floor (Hazus convention)
flood.facade_depth_note: depth at a building = median water depth over the 4 m cells touching its footprint (robust to a single deep gutter cell); Hazus applies one flood depth per structure
flood.exposed_storeys_note: multi-storey buildings: value exposed to street flooding = lowest 2 storeys / floors (USACE NACCS physical depth-damage report treats high-rise damage per affected storey; Hazus curves are whole-building for low-rise). Assumption flagged.

RES1_2.desc: two floors, no basement, Structure, A-Zone

RES1_3.desc: three or more floors, no basement, Structure, A-Zone

RES1_2.desc: two floors, no basement, Contents, A-Zone

RES1_3.desc: three or more floors, no basement, Contents, A-Zone

flood.source: FEMA Hazus FAST (Flood Assessment Structure Tool) lookup tables, Hazus 4.0 default riverine DDFs

restoration_days.use: min_days (Hazus lower bound) to stay conservative
restoration_days.source: FEMA Hazus FAST (Flood Assessment Structure Tool) lookup tables, Hazus 4.0 default riverine DDFs

economic.source: FEMA Hazus FAST (Flood Assessment Structure Tool) lookup tables, Hazus 4.0 default riverine DDFs
economic.method: Hazus Flood Technical Manual ch. 14 direct economic loss: income loss = FA x income/day x LOF days x (1 - recapture); rental/relocation = FA x rent/day x days x (1 - owner%) + FA x disruption x owner%

vehicles.min_damage_note: no damage below the first tabulated depth (0.5 ft) of EGM 09-04
vehicles.fleet_mix_used: sedan (57% of surveyed vehicles, EGM 09-04 Table Two)
vehicles.source: USACE EGM 09-04 Generic Depth-Damage Relationships for Vehicles (22 Jun 2009), Table Three

glazing.design_pressure_source: AAMA/WDMA/CSA 101/I.S.2/A440 performance grades DP20/DP30/DP40 (psf) = 958/1436/1915 Pa; structural test pressure = 1.5 x DP without breakage
glazing.capacity_note: median breakage at 2 x DP (above the 1.5 x DP proof test; ASTM E1300 designs for 8/1000 breakage at design load). Assumption flagged.

window_to_wall.source: ASHRAE 90.1 Appendix G baseline window-to-wall ratio 40% (commercial); residential 25% assumption

storefront_usd_m2.source: Insight Glass - Commercial Storefront Windows Cost: 2026 Bay Area Pricing
storefront_usd_m2.quote: standard thermally broken aluminum storefront with tempered IGU and basic Low-E runs $90 to $140 per square foot installed; Curtain Wall $200-$400 / sq ft installed. WindowServ: Fixed storefront window - tempered $12-$30/sq ft; IGU $20-$45/sq ft.

curtain_wall_usd_m2.source: Insight Glass - Commercial Storefront Windows Cost: 2026 Bay Area Pricing

glazing.facade_fraction_note: one facade (windward/peak suction face) of four

trees.car_total_loss_note: trunk of DBH >= 30 cm crushing a car = total loss (car value from cars.json); smaller stems/branches = partial claim

car_partial_source.source: National General - Storm Recovery: Impacts of Tree Falling on My Home or Car
car_partial_source.quote: the average insurance claim involving trees is over $4,000

building_strike_source.source: Triple-I Facts + Statistics: Homeowners and renters insurance (2019-2023 avg $14,747 via clayem.com; 2018-2022 avg $13,511)
building_strike_source.quote: The average claim for wind and hail damage was $13,511 (2018-2022); 2019-2023 average wind and hail claim came to $14,747; about one in 35 insured homes has a wind/hail claim per year.

trees.cleanup: failed tree: removal (tree_remove_per_cm_dbh x DBH) + replacement (tree_replace) from unit_costs.json

people.pph_source: US Census QuickFacts San Francisco County, persons per household 2019-2023 (ACS)
people.unit_area_note: gross residential floor area per dwelling unit; SF average apartment ~ 750-900 sq ft (assumption, flagged)
people.affected_rule: residents of buildings with water above first floor, or with >= 0.3 m of water at the door (access cut)
people.access_cut_source: FEMA/USGS: 12 in of moving water can float a car, 6 in knocks an adult down (NWS Turn Around Don't Drown)

vsl_source.source: HHS ASPE Standard Values for Regulatory Analysis, 2025
vsl_source.quote: HHS's current central estimate of the value per statistical life is $13.6 million
